# generality_text_fixtures_allowlist.txt -- whole files whose fleet, person or host names
# are RECORDED DATA: captured output or a verbatim excerpt of a real record, kept as it was
# written because a test reads what the real thing looked like. Not a parking place for a
# synthetic fixture that merely uses our names: those are in package-sharded generality-text ledger
# as debt, to be replaced by generic names.
#
# Format: path reason (the reason is required and names what is recorded)
#
# The list only shrinks: a row for a file with no finding any more fails the test, a new
# row is a refusal unless the file is a capture. Checked by TestGeneralityText
# (docs/SPEC-CI.md#generality-text).
#
# ceiling: 91
